rag.text:
Test: TC-4451 — Feature area - Risk - Adding existing task on Risk matrix with active quick filter (matrixCell)
Priority: Medium | Status: In Review | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-83 Feature area - Risk
Labels: teamsource

Steps:
1. Navigate to Risks module of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-4451 Feature area - Risk - Adding existing task on Risk matrix with active quick filter (matrixCell)
   Expected: Risk matrix loads. No issues are visible on the matrix.
2. Click on Quick Filters and apply filterName.
   Data: filterName: Not started tasks
   Expected: Not started tasks Quick filter is selected.
3. Click on matrixCell
   Data: matrixCell: Medium/Low
   Expected: Additional window to add task is displayed.
4. Select "Add existing task" option
   Expected: Add existing task modal appears.
5. Click on task field and input taskSummary
   Data: taskSummary: Bug
   Expected: Three of the folLowing issues are visible in the select menu:

* Bug 1
* Bug 2
* Bug 3
6. Select issueName and click on "Add another" option.
   Data: issueName: Bug 1
   Expected: Bug 1 is visible in tasks field and "Add another" option is selected.
7. Click "Add" button
   Expected: Add existing task modal remains on screen.
8. Search and select issueName
   Data: issueName: Bug 2
   Expected: Bug 2 is visible in tasks field and "Add another" option remains selected.
9. Click "Add" button
   Expected: Add existing task modal remains on screen.
10. Search and select issueName and uncheck "Add another" option.
   Data: issueName: Bug 3
   Expected: Bug 3 is visible in tasks field and "Add another" option is not selected anymore.
11. Click "Add" button
   Expected: Add existing task modal disappears. Three added issues cards are visible on the Risk matrix.
12. Refresh the page.
   Expected: Risk matrix loads. No issues are visible on the matrix.
13. Click on Quick Filters and uncheck filterName.
   Data: filterName: Not started tasks
   Expected: Quick filter is no longer applied. Three issues cards are visible on the Risk matrix.
